title: Кібератака групи UAC-0098 на державні органи України із застосуванням фреймворку Metasploit (CERT-UA#4560)

entities.name: Указ Президента України No 151 про безпрецедентні заходи безпеки.iso
entities.gloss: A malicious ISO disk image file distributed as an email attachment in a cyber attack.

entities.name: a.docx
entities.gloss: A decoy Microsoft Word document embedded within a malicious disk image.

entities.name: УКАЗ ПРЕЗИДЕНТА УКРАЇНИ №151_2022.mp4.lnk
entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file used to trigger PowerShell script execution.

entities.name: z.ps1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell script used to open a decoy document and execute a payload executable.

entities.name: b.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable file responsible for deploying Meterpreter.

entities.name: loader.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable file identified as an indicator of compromise.

entities.name: Meterpreter
entities.gloss: An advanced, dynamically extensible payload and post-exploitation tool from the Metasploit Framework.

entities.name: UAC-0098
entities.gloss: A cyber threat actor group linked to attacks against Ukrainian entities and associated with TrickBot.

entities.name: TrickBot
entities.gloss: A notorious cybercrime group known for developing and operating the TrickBot banking trojan and malware ecosystem.
